limitations: rule2 confirmed is prescribed classification confidence, not verified fire rating or legal compliance
missing sprinkler metadata uses1000m2; area sum is only a screening proxy
rule2 area<=80m2 AND configured core_kind or leading core keyword; generic shaft is not a rule2 core
area threshold is a project assumption; R4 above80m2 receives no exception
r8 removes all fire-door spread edges including opened fire doors; native flow still follows sampled opening; preserved rule limitation

positive-energy log10 normalized across floor; zero fuel contributes0, excluded from log range
vent ratio clipped at3 BEFORE min-max; gross internal/external CAD apertures, not an oxygen-network solution
binary adjacency and1-weighted_fire_fraction are not min-max normalized
closed extreme retains permanent passages; fixed glazing stays closed; no window breakage
N eligibility and existing passage usage unchanged; own room curve retained; no weight tuning
D3 automatic classifications are uncorrected, not a surveyed fuel inventory
dedicated cores excluded by existing adapter; other mislabeled/unconnected rooms retained
standby item_peak remains CAD loader value; only selected origin uses v8 fuel-based peak
whole 5F only; other hotel floors and vertical propagation not simulated
